specs.CriticalAreaLock::<default>: With (sg : StableGlobalState) (before : VarGlobalState) Require OutsideCritical(sg, before) Ensure exists observed, Crtos_RTrans(before, observed) && InsideCritical(sg, observed) * os_inv(sg, observed)
specs.CriticalAreaUnLock::<default>: With (sg : StableGlobalState) (held after : VarGlobalState) Require Crtos_GTrans(held, after) && InsideCritical(sg, held) * os_inv(sg, after) Ensure OutsideCritical(sg, after)
specs.KSemaphoreObtain::semaphore_obtain_oc: semaphore_obtain_oc With (sg : StableGlobalState) (before : VarGlobalState) X Require safeExec(LastSeen(before), abs_semaphore_obtain(sg, id, msec), X) && OutsideCritical(sg, before) Ensure exists after, safeExec(LastSeen(after), return(__return), X) && OutsideCritical(sg, after)
specs.KSemaphoreAbandon::semaphore_abandon_oc: semaphore_abandon_oc With (sg : StableGlobalState) (before : VarGlobalState) X Require safeExec(LastSeen(before), abs_semaphore_abandon(sg, id), X) && OutsideCritical(sg, before) Ensure exists after, safeExec(LastSeen(after), return(__return), X) && OutsideCritical(sg, after)
specs.PopDataqueue::<default>: With (sg : StableGlobalState) (before : VarGlobalState) (old_data old_length : option Z) X Require safeExec(LastSeen(before), abs_pop_dataqueue(sg, p_queue, timeout), X) && OutsideCritical(sg, before) * peak_data_slot(StartAddr, old_data) * peak_length_slot(size, old_length) Ensure (exists after, __return == -1 && safeExec(LastSeen(after), return(DqPopFailed), X) && OutsideCritical(sg, after) * peak_data_slot(StartAddr, old_data) * peak_length_slot(size, old_length)) || (exists after, __return == 0 && safeExec(LastSeen(after), return(DqPopEmpty), X) && OutsideCritical(sg, after) * peak_data_slot(StartAddr, old_data) * peak_length_slot(size, old_length)) || (exists after (e : DataqueueElem), __return == 0 && safeExec(LastSeen(after), return(DqPopItem(e)), X) && OutsideCritical(sg, after) * peak_data_slot(StartAddr, Some(dq_data(e))) * peak_length_slot(size, Some(dq_length(e))))
